audit.why: Difficulty EVEN / 5.5-10 matches an 81.82% sample of only 11 games (packet games=11, slice games=425); the prose already frames early Neeko dominance and a late Urgot reclaim, which fits a dashless short-range enemy vs a 800/1000-range poke kit.
Spikes are Lvl 3 (Q+E), Lvl 6 Pop Blossom (R 120/105/90s), 1st item, Late. Four entries present, matched to Neeko's real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly calls Disdain a pure gap-closer and never states that it also shields Urgot, so the reader commits burst into a shield.
audit.why: Riot text for Urgot E: 'Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies.' Cooldown 16/15.5/15/14.5/14. That shield is the reason a Neeko root-into-Q-bloom burst underperforms if thrown before E is spent.
audit.corrected: State the shield and key the commit to Disdain's ~14s downtime.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown number anywhere for the matchup-defining ability.
audit.why: Disdain is 16s at rank 1 down to 14s at rank 5 — the punish window is concrete and should be written.
audit.corrected: Use 14s as the max-rank downtime figure in the do's and interactions text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neeko's Q and Urgot's Q/E/R are all projectiles; the pages never mention it.
audit.why: Both kits carry the projectile flag. Not written because no Wind Wall-class effect is guaranteed in this lane — left alone rather than speculated.

edits.before: His flip engage — sidestep it and he has no way to start. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: His only gap-closer, and its shield blunts your burst — sidestep it and the 14s downtime is your green light.

edits.before: Urgot spends Disdain (Flip) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Disdain also shields him, so it eats your burst — bait it, then commit inside its 14s downtime.

edits.before: Track Urgot’s Disdain (Flip): His flip engage — sidestep it and he has no way to start. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Disdain (E) is his only gap-closer and it shields him through your burst — force it out, then step up in its 14s downtime.

edits.before: You out-poke a pre-item Urgot with Q while baiting his E flip; he can't all-in without landing it first.
edits.after: You out-poke pre-item Urgot with Q; Disdain (E) shields him, so trade in its 14s downtime, not into it.

notes: Level chart already agrees between phases[N].side and win[N] for all 7 rows — no chart edits needed. Several fields assert Urgot's W (Purge) deals 'percent-max-HP' damage; Riot's description and the derived flags show no percentHealth on Urgot, so I left those strings alone and logged it as unverified rather than rewrite on a guess. Sample is only 11 games (81.82%) — the EVEN rating is more trustworthy than the win rate.
